title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
706 Duke Street • Alexandria, V A 22314
202.742.8900 • www.clementmurphy.com
November 6, 2025
Via Electronic Filing

Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
1 First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20543-0001




Re: Montgomery v. Caribe Transport II, LLC, et al., No. 24-1238
Dear Mr. Harris:
I represent Petitioner in the above -captioned case.  Having conferred with Respondents’
counsel, we write jointly to request that the Court enter the following briefing schedule:
Petitioner’s brief and joint appendix:   December 1, 2025
Respondents’ brief: January 14, 2026
Petitioner’s reply: February 13, 2026
These extensions of time are  requested to  accommodate professional and personal obligations
during the briefing period.  Thank you for your consideration.
Sincerely,
Paul D. Clement
Counsel for Petitioner
cc:  All Counsel of Record
